column2: [intro]
Once upon a time, a dreamer full of grace
He aimed to conquer the world, set his own pace
But others laughed, said it was all in vain
Yet he said, "I’ll show them, I’ll break the chain"
In life, never stop, always try
No point in lamenting, reach for the sky
Just believe, keep hope, keep moving on
For anything can happen if you stay strong
He picked up his guitar, wrote melodies so bright
Without a thought if they’d like it, he took flight
He sang in the streets, on boulevards grand
And little by little, his talent took a stand
